terminal-window.label: Terminal Window
terminal-window.description: A scoped window for a terminal session. Colored dots are decoration; application CSS owns page layout.

terminal-prompt.label: Terminal Prompt
terminal-prompt.description: Visual treatment for selectable application-owned prompt text. No username, path, or command is generated by CSS.

terminal-cursor.label: Terminal Cursor
terminal-cursor.description: Decorative block cursor. Hide it from assistive technology; application code owns editing and focus. Reduced motion keeps it visible and still.

terminal-marker.label: Terminal Marker
terminal-marker.description: Textual status marker with neutral, progress, info, success, warning, danger or muted tone. Progress means active/waiting and uses amber; info stays cyan. Keep meaningful text in HTML; muted is de-emphasis, not neutral.

recommendations.toggle: Use Checkbox for a native boolean choice.
recommendations.badge: Use text status or Notice for key states.
recommendations.card: Use Panel for a native grouped surface.
recommendations.progress: Use a textual progress value when possible.
recommendations.tooltip: Prefer persistent helper text or Notice.
recommendations.segments: Prefer text progress or a Table.
recommendations.lcd: Use ordinary text inside a Panel or Terminal Window.

qa.desktop: Compact-first; verified in desktop Chrome and Firefox at emulated 390, 430, 768 and 1440 px
qa.realDevice: Real Android Chrome and iOS Safari device QA pending; not real-device/mobile-stable.

warning-status.label: Warning status recipe
warning-status.description: Czarek OS-only amber/orange treatment on an existing Badge, Notice, or Toast. Use for attention and unsaved review, not deletion or hard failure.

icon-busy-button.label: Leading icon and busy button recipe
icon-busy-button.description: Czarek OS-only icon sizing and CSS spinner. Application JavaScript sets aria-busy and disabled, then restores both when the action finishes. Supply an accessible name for icon-only buttons.

enhanced-select.label: Enhanced Select
enhanced-select.description: Czarek OS alpha visual primitive for an application-owned combobox/listbox. Use aria-selected for selection and data-active for keyboard highlight. Dirty means unsaved; aria-invalid visually wins over dirty. The application owns keys, focus, value, form synchronization and popup placement.

measurement-readout.label: Measurement Readout
measurement-readout.description: Czarek OS alpha technical value surface with mono tabular numbers and a secondary unit. Use shared Badge or Notice for alarm meaning; this is not an LCD.

section-icon.label: Section Icon
section-icon.description: Czarek OS alpha decorative icon surface for an ordinary section heading. The application supplies the SVG and heading layout; the icon is not an action.
section-icon.markup: Device settings

recommendations.toggle: Use a native Checkbox for clear boolean settings until the switch treatment is validated.
recommendations.progress: Use text progress or a Table in dense workspaces.
recommendations.range: Use a numeric Input for precise production values.
recommendations.menu: Use visible actions or a native Select for values; Menu remains a fallback command layer.
recommendations.dialog: Use sparingly; the native Showcase keeps editing in context.
recommendations.tooltip: Prefer persistent helper text next to form controls.
recommendations.segments: Use text progress or a Table.
recommendations.lcd: Use ordinary text in a Panel or Card.
recommendations.status-led: Use explicit text and a semantic Badge.

qa.desktop: Verified in Chrome and Firefox on Windows at 1440, 768, 414, and 390 px; native Showcase and candidate QA.
qa.realDevice: Android Chrome, iOS Safari, and Safari desktop remain untested.
